data.imageAlt: VNet-app containing Subnet-web with VM-web-01 (showing NIC nic-web-01) and a future VM-web-02. An NSG labelled nsg-web-rules sits to the right with an arrow pointing at the subnet.
data.answer: Associate the NSG with Subnet-web. Subnet-level association applies the rules to all current and future VMs in the subnet automatically.
data.explanation: Associating an NSG with a NIC only protects that one VM — every new VM added to the subnet would need its own NSG association manually. Associating at the VNet level is not supported. Subnet-level association is the correct choice: all traffic entering or leaving any NIC in Subnet-web passes through the subnet NSG, including VMs added in the future. This is the standard pattern for applying consistent network controls to a tier.
